messages:
Asha (People Ops): Thanks everyone — following up from today’s All-Hands Q&A. I’m threading the action items and answers here so managers can pick up next steps.

Jordan (Eng Manager): Quick one — how should we explain calibration to ICs? People asked what "level" vs "band" means.

Asha (People Ops): Short version: level = scope & role (e.g., L3/L4), band = comp bucket tied to market data. We’ll share a one-pager for managers.

Priya (SWE): Can you confirm timeline for promotion decisions + when letters go out? Several folks pinged me after the meeting.

Asha (People Ops): Promotions: manager calibration due by 2026-04-10, final committee week of 2026-04-17, letters targeted 2026-04-24. Appeals window: 14 days after letters.

Kai (Manager): If an appeal is approved, is there retroactive pay? People asked if raises backdated to review date or approval date.

Liam (Benefits): If an appeal results in an approved comp adjustment we apply retroactive pay back to the effective date stated in the committee memo (usually the start of the cycle). Retro pay hits the next payroll after approval.

Priya (SWE): Thx — also, will leveling changes affect equity refreshers or is that separate?

Asha (People Ops): Leveling and equity are evaluated separately but part of the same packet. If comp + level change, equity recommendations go with the promotion package. Managers: include equity ask in your calibration notes.

Jordan (Eng Manager): For communication: can we get a manager script or bullets for 1:1s? I don’t want to improvise on the spot.

Asha (People Ops): Yep — manager script + FAQ will be posted to the handbook and linked in the manager digest by 2026-04-20.

Sam (CEO): Quick note from leadership: we trust managers to be candid. If someone asks why they didn’t get a promotion this cycle, stick to performance examples + clear growth plan. We’ll fund promotions where the committee agrees.

Priya (SWE): Is there guidance on external offers and market adjustments? Someone is considering an offer and asked if we do counteroffers.

Asha (People Ops): We don’t do blanket counteroffers. For retention/market cases, managers submit a market-adjustment case: include comp data and intent to retain. Committee reviews on rolling basis.

Kai (Manager): Small thing — where do we submit calibration docs? I saw two different folders.

Asha (People Ops): Single source: /handbook/people-ops/calibration/2026-cycle — use the template in that folder. Links in manager digest.

PeopleBot: Reminder: Calibration template due in 7 days for members assigned to group alpha. :bell:

Jordan (Eng Manager): Any change to comp band mid-year if someone gets an OTE/bonus? We had a question about how bonuses affect total comp banding.

Liam (Benefits): One-time bonuses do not move someone into a different comp band. Ongoing adjustments (base increases) will be evaluated in the next calibration.

Asha (People Ops): Capturing action items:```- Share manager script + FAQ by 2026-04-20
- Finalize calibration template + single folder link (done)
- Managers finalize notes by 2026-04-10
- Committee meets week of 2026-04-17
- Letters out 2026-04-24
- Appeals window 14 days after letters
- Retro pay processed on next payroll after approval```

Priya (SWE): Thanks Asha — can you also add a sample growth plan template for folks who are not promoted? That'd help managers.

Asha (People Ops): Will do. Adding sample growth plan to the manager packet.

Jordan (Eng Manager): One last ask — can we get anonymized benchmarking ranges to share in 1:1s, not individual comp? Managers need confidence when explaining market position.

Liam (Benefits): We can share band ranges and percentile guidance (e.g., 50/75/90) but not individual salary info. Will include in the manager packet.

Sam (CEO): Thanks all — appreciate the focused Qs. Managers: please escalate anything urgent to me or Asha.

Asha (People Ops): Closing thread for now — tagging deliverables and will ping when manager digest is live. :sparkles:
